ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 1.8:1 ratio of high-intensity white pixels to low-intensity black pixels across the visible surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Two large, contiguous high-intensity white segments dominate the center of each lobe. A solid low-intensity black band follows the entire trailing edge, broadening significantly at the median notch and along the lower vertical axis where the fluke meets the water line. Fine-scale black mottling is present at the interior margins of the white blobs.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Calculated V-shaped depression angle of 34 degrees with a depth approximately 12% of the vertical height of the visible fluke lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serration pattern along the continuous trailing boundary; pixel-amplitude of peaks and valleys ranges from 4 to 15 pixels, with the highest frequency of serration concentrated on the outer third of each lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Leading edges exhibit a steady convex curve from the water line to the tips; trailing edges follow a complex convex curve that tapers into the median notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized clusters of high-contrast, roughly circular pixel groups (clusters of 8-12 pixels each) are detected at the distal tips of both the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Three distinct, near-parallel vertical linear pixel disruptions are visible in the high-intensity white field of the right lobe, oriented toward the lower water line.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Proninent irregular texture and loss of smooth edge contour at the terminal tips of both lobes, indicative of physical trauma or parasitic colonization.
